dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows a file in more places than it asks for one: the documents attached to a form, each on a line with its size and how far its sending has come; the pictures attached to a message, as a strip of small tiles; a record's attachments, read and opened and no longer removed. It is the same file each time — a glyph that says its format or a small picture of it, its name, what is known of it, and the actions to take it back or try it again — drawn alike wherever it stands.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a file item reads: the colors and text styles of the format glyph, the name and the second line; the status mark and its two status colors; the progress bar; the remove and retry actions; the ground behind a picture; its timings; and, for each form (row, tile), the sizes of that form and, in each state, the ground of a pressable body and the colors of an action.
rules: A file item shows one file and knows nothing of it but what its props say. It never uploads, reads or keeps a file; the picture of an image is drawn by the platform from the address or the handle the product gives.
The glyph says the file's format — one of ten kinds — in one color. Never color a format: a color in Tanrei means one thing everywhere, and a format is not a status.
A status is always words (statusText, errorText); the mark and its color are one more sign.

Choose the form by where the file stands: row in a column of files with their progress; tile in a strip of pictures. A list of files is a column or a strip of file items, or a File upload, which arranges them; for an order people change, each file item is the content of a List's row.
State tokens are valued by the design system's pattern rules; each form's state-layer.color is the name's color and an action's is its glyph's.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a file's row or tile by hand.

color.$description: The glyph of the file's format, whatever the format: secondary content. A format has no color of its own.
The ground of a tile's box and of a row's picture box: seen behind a format glyph, around a picture that is fitted whole, and until a picture is drawn.

typescale.$description: The file's name: a list row's headline.

color.$description: The file's name: the surface's text color.

typescale.$description: The second line — the format, the size and the status, or the error: a list row's supporting text.

color.$description: The format, the size and the status: secondary content.

size.$description: The mark before the words of a file that is done or failed, on the second line.

gap.$description: The space between that mark and the words it stands before.

color.$description: The mark of a file that is done: the success role, used for that status alone. The status is also said in words.
The mark of a file that failed: the error role.
The error text of a file that failed, in place of its status: the error role, used for errors and nothing else.

thickness.$description: The height of the progress bar: its container height, the small linear progress indicator's.

shape.$description: The ends of the bar's track and indicator in a row, clamped to half the thickness. In a tile the bar is clipped by the box's corners.

gap.$description: The space between a row's texts and its progress bar.

color.$description: The bar's track: the low-emphasis fill tracks have. Opaque, so the bar is read over a picture.
The part of the bar that is done: primary, as a progress indicator's.

size.$description: The side of an action's square container (retry, remove): its container height. Its hit area meets the minimum target.

shape.$description: The corners of an action's container and state layer: a circle in the default system, as an icon-only button.

size.$description: An action's glyph, and the mark of a link that opens a new context.

gap.$description: The space between the two actions: with their size it puts their centres one touch target apart.

state-duration.$description: How long a change of the colors of the body or of an action takes between states.

feedback-duration.$description: How long the answer to a press takes to spread when sys.behavior.pressed-feedback is ripple (as Button's). Unused by the other choices.

progress-duration.$description: How long the bar takes to reach a new value: the progress indicator's.

cycle-duration.$description: One cycle of the bar while how far it has come is unknown, and one pulse of its reduced-motion form: the progress indicator's.

cycle-easing.$description: How the segment and the pulse move through a cycle.

color.$description: The ground of the row's body at rest: none. Hover, focus and a press mix the state layer into it, over the glyph or the picture, while the body is pressable.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A row draws no fill at rest; its states draw the state layer.

gap.$description: The space between a row's glyph or picture, its texts and its actions.

shape.$description: The corners of the state layer and of the focus ring of a pressable row's body.

outset.$description: How far the state layer of a pressable row's body reaches beyond its glyph and texts on every side. It takes no room: the row is laid out as a row that cannot be pressed.

color.$description: The color hover, focus and press mix into the body of a pressable row: the color of the file's name.
A row action's fill at rest: none.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A row action draws no fill at rest; its states draw the state layer.

color.$description: The glyph of the row's remove and retry actions: secondary content, as a quiet icon-only button's.
The color hover, focus and press mix into an action of the row: its glyph's color.

size.$description: The glyph of the file's format before a row's texts: a list row's leading glyph.

height.$description: The side of the square a row draws its picture in while preview is true, and its glyph centred in while there is no picture: its container height, a list row's leading picture.

shape.$description: The corners of a row's picture.

color.$description: The ground of the tile's body at rest: none. Hover, focus and a press mix the state layer into it, over the glyph or the picture, while the body is pressable.

dev.tanrei.derive.fixed: A tile draws no fill over its picture at rest; its states draw the state layer.

gap.$description: The space between a tile's box and the texts beneath it.

shape.$description: The corners of a tile's box, of the picture clipped to it, and of the body's state layer and focus ring: a card's.

color.$description: The color hover, focus and press mix into the body of a pressable tile: the color of the file's name.
The disc under a tile's action: the lowest surface, opaque, so that the glyph is read over any picture.
The glyph of the tile's remove and retry actions: secondary content, as a quiet icon-only button's.
The color hover, focus and press mix into an action of the tile: its glyph's color.

inset.$description: How far a tile's actions stand from the top and the end edge of its box.

size.$description: The glyph of the file's format in the middle of a tile that draws no picture.

height.$description: The height of a tile's box where the product gives none, and its width where the product gives none: its container height. A tile is a square unless the product says otherwise.
